Taco Express Peabody is inside Eatery 58 at Mills 58.

Address: 58 Pulaski Street, Unit B, Peabody, MA 01960
Phone: (978) 982-1800
Hours: Wednesday through Sunday, 11 AM–6 PM. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

Voice ordering with Diego: https://www.tacoexpresspeabody.com/voice

Taco Express Peabody serves tacos, burritos, enchiladas, loaded quesadillas, sides, fryer favorites, and beverages.
